comment_box: The Dept of Veteran's affairs is to provide health care to veterans.  Abortion is not health care; it does not treat any illness or correct any physical damage. Abortion kills a unique human being.  Abortion also causes both physical and psychological harm to the mother. Compared to women who gave birth, women who have aborted have a six-times higher rate of suicide, greater complications with future pregnancies. Excluding women with a prior history of substance abuse, those who abort their first pregnancy are 5 times more likely to report subsequent drug and alcohol abuse vs. those who give birth. Veterans with difficulties concerning their pregnancies should be referred to the Option Line. They will be able to talk (or online chat) to someone immediately. 24/7, English or Spanish, and then be connected to an international network of pregnancy help centers who can give them local support.
